title: wsblast baseline comparison (schema 1.1.x)
description: Output of `wsblast --compare BASELINE CURRENT --format json` (also written by `-o FILE`). Derived from `JsonComparison`, `Regression` and `Improvement` in src/report.rs. The baseline and current metrics themselves are not included. Readers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: Comparison schema version. wsblast 0.1.x and 0.2.0 write "1.1.0".

threshold.description: The --compare-threshold value in percent (default 10). A metric is listed only when the absolute relative change is strictly greater than this value.

regressions.description: Metrics that moved in the bad direction by more than the threshold, sorted by metric name. A non-empty list makes --fail-on-regression exit with code 2.

improvements.description: Metrics that moved in the good direction by more than the threshold, sorted by metric name.

metric.description: Compared metric. Higher is better for total_connections_established, total_messages_sent, total_messages_recv, total_bytes_sent, total_bytes_recv, throughput_msg_per_sec and throughput_bytes_per_sec. Lower is better for total_connections_failed, error_rate, errors.<category> (one per error_breakdown key, such as errors.timeout), and handshake_latency.{p50,p95,p99,p999}_us and message_rtt.{p50,p95,p99,p999}_us. total_connections_attempted is never compared.

baseline.description: Value in the baseline report (0 when the metric is absent there, for example a new error category).

current.description: Value in the current report (0 when absent).

pct_change.description: Signed relative change in percent: (current - baseline) / baseline * 100. When the baseline is 0 and the current value is not, this is exactly 100.
